I am a PhD student in Digital Economics and Industrial Organization at [Institut Mines-Télécom Business School](https://www.imt-bs.eu/), supervised by Grazia Cecere and Antonio Russo.

My research focuses on digital economics, industrial organization and the economics of artificial intelligence. I am currently studying how generative AI is used in advertising and media occupations.

Before starting my PhD, I completed a Master in Economics of Markets and Organizations at the Toulouse School of Economics.

## Research interests

Digital Economics · Industrial Organization · Economics of Artificial Intelligence · Labor Economics
